card.line: The Negev is the dry southern region of Canaan, where Abram traveled, Isaac lived, the spies passed through, and Caleb's daughter received land and springs.

moments.title: Abram travels toward the Negev
moments.text: Abram journeyed on toward the Negev. Then a severe famine came, and he went down to Egypt. Later he came back up into the Negev with his wife, Lot, and all his possessions.

moments.title: Isaac lives in the Negev
moments.text: Isaac was living in the Negev after returning from Beer-lahai-roi. One evening he saw Rebekah coming, and he took her as his wife and was comforted.

moments.title: The spies go through the Negev
moments.text: Moses sent men to spy out Canaan and told them to go up through the Negev. They came to Hebron, then brought back fruit and a report.

moments.title: The spies report on the Negev
moments.text: The spies said the land flowed with milk and honey but its people were strong. They said the Amalekites lived in the Negev, and Caleb urged the people to take the land.

moments.title: Acsah asks for springs
moments.text: Caleb had given his daughter Acsah land in the Negev. She asked him for springs of water too, and he gave her the upper and lower springs.
